# Hunker

> > Hunker is a home improvement and design publication offering DIY projects, repair guides, interior design inspiration, and real estate advice.

The site features expert contributors including designers from Breathe Design Studio, writers like Emily Ray and Elizabeth Stamp, and covers topics from budget-friendly Dollar Tree crafts to celebrity homes featured on HGTV. Hunker provides practical tutorials for homeowners tackling everything from plumbing repairs to seasonal home maintenance.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design
- Home Repair & Maintenance
- DIY Projects
- Pest Control
- Home Decor
- Budget Crafts
- Plumbing
- Paint Ideas
- Storage Solutions
- Celebrity Homes
- Flooring
- Winter Preparation
- Real Estate & Home Staging
- HGTV Design Trends
- Dollar Tree DIY

## Home Repair & Maintenance

- [Repair - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/repair?page=31): Home repair tutorials for interior and exterior maintenance projects
- [Interior Home Repair - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/electrical-repairs?page=12): Interior repair guides covering plumbing, pest control, and maintenance tips

## Design & Decor

- [Design - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/home-design?page=3): Home design articles featuring DIY tips, decor ideas, and celebrity homes

## Real Estate

- [Real Estate - Hunker](https://www.hunker.com/houses?page=11): Real estate advice on market trends, buying, selling, and home staging
